deterministic_command: import{createHash}from'node:crypto';import{mkdirSync,readFileSync,writeFileSync}from'node:fs';import{basename,join,relative}from'node:path';const root=process.cwd();const profilePaths=['.opsle/evidence/activation-profiles/prior-defective.json','.opsle/evidence/activation-profiles/corrected-live.json'];const rawDir=join(root,'.opsle/evidence/raw/trajectory-snapshots');mkdirSync(rawDir,{recursive:true,mode:0o700});const sha=b=>createHash('sha256').update(b).digest('hex');const entries=[];for(const profilePath of profilePaths){const profile=JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(root,profilePath),'utf8'));const source=readFileSync(profile.trajectory_evidence.path);const target=profile.trajectory_evidence.sha256;let exact=null;if(sha(source)===target)exact=source;else{const h=createHash('sha256');let start=0;for(let i=0;i<source.length;i+=1){if(source[i]!==10)continue;h.update(source.subarray(start,i+1));start=i+1;if(h.copy().digest('hex')===target){exact=source.subarray(0,i+1);break;}}}if(!exact||exact.at(-1)!==10||sha(exact)!==target)throw new Error('no exact newline-bounded trajectory source for '+profilePath);const snapshot=join(rawDir,basename(profilePath,'.json')+'-'+target+'.jsonl');writeFileSync(snapshot,exact,{mode:0o600,flag:'wx'});entries.push({profile:profilePath,original_path:profile.trajectory_evidence.path,snapshot_path:relative(root,snapshot),sha256:target,bytes:exact.length,interval:profile.interval});}writeFileSync(join(root,'.opsle/evidence/activation-profiles/trajectory-snapshots.json'),JSON.stringify({schema:'opsle.durable-supervisor.trajectory-snapshot-manifest/v1',entries},null,2)+'\n',{mode:0o600,flag:'wx'});
expected_deliverable: Two exact mode-0600 raw trajectory snapshots and one compact manifest mapping every imported profile to original path, stable snapshot path, exact byte count, SHA-256, and interval.

each snapshot ends on a JSONL newline boundary
manifest references both profiles and snapshots
